en:
## Improvements

- Increased PWA maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes limit to 4MB to accommodate growing bundle size
- Upgraded test infrastructure: replaced hand-written DDL with Drizzle migration SQL replay, ensuring test schema always matches production
- Aligned test assertions with current production defaults (slugify CJK support, default model name, tool renames, schema validators)
zh-CN:
## 改进

- 提升 PWA maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes 限制至 4MB 以适应不断增长的打包体积
- 升级测试基础设施：用 Drizzle 迁移 SQL 回放替代手写 DDL，确保测试 schema 始终与生产一致
- 对齐测试断言与当前生产默认值（slugify CJK 支持、默认模型名称、工具重命名、schema 校验器）
